description: This file defines the custom exception class JournalEntryNotFoundException used for signaling that a journal entry resource was not found. It extends an abstract exception class and provides constructors for different identification methods (transaction ID and entry ID).

classes.name: JournalEntryNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating that a journal entry resource was not found based on provided identifiers.

methods.name: JournalEntryNotFoundException(String transactionId)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception when a journal entry with the given transaction ID does not exist or is not system generated/reversible.

methods.name: JournalEntryNotFoundException(Long entryId)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception when a journal entry with the specified entry ID does not exist.
